basis: Unchanged B07 syn-1 definitions, team-v1.1 section 4; fictional only.

common_rules.missing_rule: Only native empty string and NULL mean missing in used fields. No NA, Unknown or numeric sentinel is declared. Unused columns remain native blanks and have no business mapping.
common_rules.keys: Keep exact text and component order, including leading zeros. Empty or all-whitespace keys block. C calls A's SQL key encoder; this generator creates no business keys.
common_rules.counts: Counts use nonnegative whole people or units as stated per field. Invalid integers and negative counts block. Any missing component makes its casualty sum NULL; never substitute zero.
common_rules.dates: NSW and QLD have year/month precision; never add a day. Missing month with a known year gives year precision. VIC dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates. English month names use the fixed January–December table in 05 section 3.
common_rules.scope_filter: Resolve parent crash keys against the full native crash snapshot before applying the inclusive analysis years. A missing parent is an orphan, not an out-of-range record.

person_mapping.destination: Raw only; no Person entity is created in Canonical or DW.

vehicle_reference.empty_vehicle_id: Allowed: a Person need not be linked to a vehicle in this fictional definition.

person_mapping.count_scope: One person per row; compare per-accident count to NO_PERSONS. Injury categories are not populated or mapped for this fixture.

declared_person_count.scope: All Person rows for the same accident, including legal empty vehicle references.
